data.name: Kausari
data.gender_notes: Kausari is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A fragrant saffron flower. The name Kausari carries the meaning “A kind of saffron” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Kausari usually hope their child will grow to embody a kind of saffron and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents grace, beauty, and elegance. Often used as a metaphor for inner beauty and purity in Islamic literature.
data.etymology: Kausari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A kind of saffron.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kausari total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: كوثري
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من كوثر، نهر في الجنة، الكثير الخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم كوثري مشتق من كلمة كوثر التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، وتعني النهر الذي يوجد في الجنة، ويعبر عن الكثير من الخير والفضل. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية ودلالات إيجابية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: کوثری
in_urdu.meaning: کوثر سے مشتق، جنت کا ایک دریا، بہت زیادہ خیر
in_urdu.long_meaning: کوثری نام کوثر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے اور جنت میں ایک دریا کے نام سے منسوب ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاص طور پر اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ خیر اور برکت کی علامت ہے۔ اس کا استعمال جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں روایتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कौसरी
in_hindi.meaning: कोथर से व्युत्पन्न, स्वर्ग की एक नदी, बहुतायत में अच्छाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: कौसरी नाम की उत्पत्ति कोथर शब्द से हुई है, जो कुरआन में उल्लिखित स्वर्ग की एक नदी को संदर्भित करता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक रूप से प्रयोग किया जाता है और इसे अच्छाई और आध्यात्मिक महत्व के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: کوسري
in_pashto.meaning: د کوثر څخه مشتق، په جنت کې يو سيند، ډير خير
in_pashto.long_meaning: کوسري نوم د کوثر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چي په قرآن کې ذکر شوی دی او په جنت کې د يو سيند نوم دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره ځانګړی اهمیت لري، ځکه چې دا د خير او برکت نښه ده.

in_english.name: Kausari
in_english.meaning: Abundant goodness, river in Paradise, spiritual blessings
in_english.long_meaning: Kausari is derived from the Arabic root 'Kawthar', which refers to a river in Paradise mentioned in the Quran (108:1). The name symbolizes abundance, goodness, and spiritual blessings. Historically, it has been used in various Muslim cultures, reflecting its significance in Islamic tradition. The name Kausari conveys positive personality traits such as generosity and piety.

data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Kausari holds a significant spiritual significance as it is reminiscent of the beautiful fragrance of the Garden of Paradise, emphasizing the pursuit of purity, virtue, and inner beauty in one's journey towards spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "A kind of saffron" symbolizes A fragrant saffron flower. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kausari serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of a kind of saffron.
